story: The Sri Lanka Indian Peafowl (Pavo cristatus) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Phasianidae family. It is most commonly observed in Deciduous/open forest; dry semi-desert grasslands; scrub; agricultural land; and areas near water, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Least Concern (LC) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Sri Lanka Indian Peafowl is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Sri Lanka Indian Peafowl into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
